title: Pointed etale ring-colimit presentation of strict henselization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and barY:Spec Omega -> Spec R a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] with image y. Let H be strictHenselizationRing barY [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] and b:R -> H have spectrum equal to strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. There are a small cofiltered category I, a ring diagram F:I^op -> CommRing, a colimit cocone c [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a natural family a_j:R -> F(j), and an isomorphism e:c.pt -> H, such that a_j;c.iota_j;e=b for every j. For every j, Spec(a_j) is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and has a point z_j over y [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

proof.text: Use the chosen small representative category, strictHenselizationDiagram and its canonical colimit cocone. strictHenselization_properties supplies cofilteredness. Take e to be the identity isomorphism.

Define the base-ring maps by Spec.preimage of the affine-global-section comparison followed by the neighbourhood structure map. GammaSpecIso_inv_naturality and the over-category equation prove naturality. Spec.map_injective and the characterization of strictHenselizationStructuralMap prove their composite with each colimit leg is b.

Etaleness follows from the neighbourhood structure and the affine comparison isomorphism. Choose the zero prime of Omega, map it by the lift and the affine comparison, and use the over-category equality and hy to show the resulting point maps to y.

lean.statement: theorem pointed_etale_ring_colimit (R : CommRingCat.{u}) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R) (y : Spec R) (hy : ∀ x : Spec (.of Ω), barY x = y) (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY) (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY) : ∃ (I : Type u) (cat : Category.{u} I), letI := cat ∃ (_ : IsCofiltered I) (F : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F) (a : (Functor.const Iᵒᵖ).obj R ⟶ F) (e : c.pt ≅ strictHenselizationRing barY), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ (∀ j, a.app j ≫ c.ι.app j ≫ e.hom = b) ∧ ∀ j, Etale (Spec.map (a.app j)) ∧ ∃ z : Spec (F.obj j), (Spec.map (a.app j)) z = y
